scope: Exploratory measurements on nine already labeled ranges; not blind prediction or model validation
source: Native closed 1m OHLCV from C_simetria1855_base.csv;9cases from C_matriz_bordes_resultados.json
geometry: START/END open and close position within H-L
absolute START/END body divided by H-L
close total variation divided by H-L
mean absolute body and upper/lower wick divided by H-L
EMA_proxy_definitions: Fixed close EMAs, alpha2/(N+1), seeded at first loaded close. First6periods derive from known output architecture at C60, not claimed to be author's hidden historical lengths.72/89 added separately as longer exploratory proxies. Do not optimize lengths using C.
history_sensitivity: Report loaded prehistory bars and retained seed coefficient. Recompute with first-close +/-100point seed as explicit sensitivity check, not a guaranteed bound on unknown true history. Signs with differing sensitivity variants are marked uncertain.
EMA_measurements: At START and END: close-minus-EMA divided by H-L, EMA one-bar slope divided by H-L. For first6periods, cloud pair widths and above/below/between state at each endpoint. Also count close/EMA sign crossings inside range.
candidate_check: Group same first6 endpoint above/below signatures and same3 cloud-state signatures; different C in a group rejects those particular state-only mappings. Do not claim rejection of all EMA/harmonic models. No regression or threshold tuning to nine labels.
symmetry: Use absolute or orientation-aware geometry. Verify each feature's behavior under price reflection before claiming invariance. Signed measures intentionally reverse; no universal invariance assumed.
